title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: Dolby B metal cassette master > 20-bit SBM2 > CDR (David Gans master) > EAC > SoundForge
source: Set 1 SBD > Dolby B metal cassette master. Set 2  SBD > ? (likely cassette master)

ai_review.summary: Rich soundboard capture of an solid early‑'80s show featuring a standout Morning Dew and the quirky Me & My Uncle false start.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, ambient mix with strong bass—typical of post‑April ’82 SBD releases—making it a very listenable source. The performance is generally above average; highlights include a powerful Morning Dew and the memorable Me & My Uncle false start, while tension between Bob and Phil during the Spanish Jam adds character despite Phil’s off‑night. Overall the show feels consistently good without any glaring dips.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 3–5 stars and note strong musical moments plus a high‑quality soundboard, outweighing minor performance quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Rich, ambient mix with solid bass; typical post‑April ’82 SBD improvements in clarity and balance; no muffled bass issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently good throughout; no single section dominates but the show maintains a steady, engaging flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Great throughout with solid guitar work noted by attendees.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mixed feedback – some feel he was off‑night, others praise his authoritative playing and presence in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Strong performance overall; tension over Spanish Jam but still a great contribution.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keys) highlighted as great throughout the show.
